speaker: Matthew J. Eyring
title: Comfort from the Holy Ghost
summary: Elder Matthew J. Eyring teaches that everyone sooner or later meets burdens they cannot carry or fix alone, and that Jesus Christ comforts us through the Holy Ghost and has already prepared our rescue from death and sin. He tells of a friend whose married son died suddenly, and of a dinner with a young couple who, like him and his wife, lost a twin before birth, ending with a priesthood blessing that promised the grieving father peace. He asks us to turn to the Lord with our burdens, to make living worthy of the Holy Ghost's constant companionship one of our highest priorities, and to place our faith and hope in Christ.
